audit_method.entry_path: QAService.execute -> QAAgent.run_detailed -> graph retrieve/sufficiency/answer/verify/revise/finalize; Retriever.retrieve -> analyze and channels/selection
audit_method.counting_rule: One row per bounded behavior family. production_residual_findings counts is_production_residual=true only. HOLD, generic/domain, aggregate D4 and evaluator-only rows are excluded. Candidate-owner counts use production residual rows only; keep counts use primary classification. R04 includes its coupled finalizer locator; R10 is excluded from R08/R09 totals.
audit_method.provenance_limit: Four targeted git log -S checks plus pointer/policy follow-ups and targeted blame trace suspicious literals to initial imported source 3d90848. Import age alone does not prove benchmark origin.

findings.behavior: Intent policy mandates paper for theory and paper plus code for implementation. analyze transfers requirements into the plan; paper retrieval, selection, and QA sufficiency consume them.

evidence: src/panda_agent/retrieval.py:1150-1155 explicitly says gold policy requires literature for these two intents

findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 can derive question-only facets without adopting intent-to-source mandates.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Consider question-grounded source obligations in a separately authorized F2 change; preserve safety and assess E3 interaction.
findings.rationale: Explicit provenance applies to the paper-intent policy, not automatically to every other source requirement or budget.

findings.behavior: Installation requires documentation; usage documentation/code; API code; data_flow workflow/code; module_structure code/graph; troubleshooting documentation/code. These affect production sufficiency.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: Question-only decomposition is separable from these downstream source requirements.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain pending product-contract/provenance review; do not count as substantiated benchmark debt.
findings.rationale: The mappings are observable; available comments do not establish a Gold origin for each non-paper mapping. Determinism and domain specificity alone are insufficient.

findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 need not inherit the refusal template.

findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain on HOLD for numeric-sufficiency provenance/contract review; do not label it a proven benchmark-specific rule.
findings.rationale: Generic exact-numeric evidence caution is legitimate. This implementation is narrower, but available static history does not prove benchmark derivation; no runtime defect is repaired or empirically asserted.

findings.behavior: Live question and plan activate workflow, handoff, factory, acceptance, reader, theory-fit, module and troubleshooting obligations used during generation/review/revision.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 question-only output can run alongside these legacy obligations with separate provenance.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain during diagnostic E1 work; map migration to dynamic decomposition and claim/point coverage in E1/E2.
findings.rationale: Regression-shaped obligations use actual question/plan and require evidence-backed answers; there is no runtime Gold answer-point input. Treat as compatibility, not immediate F2 deletion. Pointer-specific enforcement is separately R10.

findings.behavior: Selects existing evidence by named requirement, truncates around domain anchors, and checks required claim vocabulary and, for selected requirements, cited-evidence links. Missing requirements drive one revision and may coexist with salvaged supported claims.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 can remain question-only and diagnostic; eventual replacement of enforcement belongs to E2.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain and assess coverage equivalence in E1/E2; do not translate keyword checks into new Gold-shaped decomposition points.
findings.rationale: Named domain checks are bespoke but currently support completeness over live evidence. Not every check itself verifies entailment; ordinary citation/review checks remain separate. Excludes R10 pointer literal.

findings.behavior: A generic pointer-normalization request activates a check that specifically requires pndlmdtrackq and underlying/pointer-syntax wording; evidence compaction also uses PndLmdTrackQ anchors.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 is not blocked if it derives facets from the question and does not reuse this hard-coded completion predicate.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Review genericization of the hard-coded symbol under F2 in coordination with E1/E2; preserve existing behavior in F1.
findings.rationale: Regression-protected exact-symbol enforcement is stronger than the generic live-query trigger. Distinct narrow specialization within R08/R09, not evidence that all completeness obligations should be removed.

findings.behavior: Planned-locator augmentation requires a query-named planned identifier and selected evidence; dataflow augmentation uses planned symbols/required types and actual evidence. Module-boundary prompts treat plan symbols as required components.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 can derive requirements without plan symbols or retrieved evidence and be observed separately.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain compatibility; E1/E2 should distinguish question requirements from upstream plan suggestions before replacing it.
findings.rationale: No new fixed answer path is encoded by the helpers. Plan may contain D4-derived symbols; internal required_* and dataflow_locator_* claims are filtered from public answers. required_boundary_locators can still shape generated content.

findings.behavior: Insufficiency triggers one retry except version conflicts; query suffix includes required source types and error text, missing-symbol errors extend the reused plan, and evidence merges with a fixed 12-item truncation.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: E1 decomposition can be implemented independently of targeted retrieval activation.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Review before E3 becomes authoritative, preserving C8/global-merge boundary; do not execute targeted retrieval in F1.
findings.rationale: Mechanism follows sufficiency errors, not missing decomposed answer points, and generic refusals can also enter it. Static architectural mismatch is clear; exact benchmark origin is not.

findings.behavior: Identifier/path matches, code-source membership and comparison wording can mark whole claims deterministically supported; such claims skip semantic unsupported-claim errors. Explicit token whitelist includes createLmdFitData, fillData and other names.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: Downstream claim verification can be kept unchanged during an independently observable E1 implementation.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Review support-override generalization under F2 and the later verifier-role boundary; preserve citation/version checks.
findings.rationale: Observed bespoke support override, not ordinary citation-integrity checking: matching identifiers is not semantic entailment. Exact historical benchmark derivation is unproven; static policy risk is sufficient for a bounded guard candidate, not a measured regression claim.

findings.behavior: Plan hints, required types and exact symbols are promoted before reranker order; mandatory symbols can bypass caps; two-pass backfill admits required types only into unused capacity.

evidence: docs/GENERALIZATION_ROADMAP.md Phase B/B5 and C7 deferred coverage/ranking outcome

findings.e1_blocking_rationale: Selection debt does not prevent question-only E1 design.

findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Retain on HOLD for relevance/ownership review at retrieval/E3 boundary; do not count as proven benchmark debt.
findings.rationale: Potential source-coverage accommodation is observable, but sparse-corpus fallback may be legitimate. Historical origin and usefulness are not established by static evidence; not classified as a fixed exact-object shortcut.

findings.behavior: Generic future-runtime impossibility, same-domain formal-proof sufficiency, qualified unknown-API catalog lookup and deleted-runtime impossibility apply across question classes; refusal bases can rank already retrieved query-related evidence.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: Generic safety is compatible with independent E1.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Keep generic guards and their evidence boundaries; do not claim they already cover every bare unknown class.
findings.rationale: No benchmark case ID or dedicated answer locator is required by the generic guard core. Fixed finalizer exceptions are separately R04-R06; catalog coverage limitations do not make the generic mechanism benchmark debt.

location.symbol_or_anchor: runtime question objective / citation integrity / internal claim filtering

findings.behavior: Runtime objective is question_core from the actual question. Validate claim/evidence IDs, versions and precise locators; filter internal scope/coverage claims; suppress unrequested external identifiers; render supported claims only.
findings.e1_blocking_rationale: The single-point interface is an implementation integration seam, not an unavoidable benchmark-derived decomposition constraint.
findings.recommended_action: Do not change in F1; Keep integrity checks; E1/E2 may intentionally replace the single runtime point with question-derived multiple points under separate authorization.
findings.rationale: Generic provenance/presentation boundaries are distinct from R13 semantic support overrides. The hard-coded Sphinx date in scope_* construction is internal audit text filtered before public claims.

findings.behavior: Only case.query enters QAAgent.run_detailed; deterministic Gold metrics and optional external judge are applied after the production result returns.
